# Beluga AI

> > Beluga AI is a Go-native agentic framework for building production-ready AI agents with 22+ LLM providers, streaming-first architecture, and enterprise-grade observability.

Beluga AI provides a comprehensive Go framework for AI agent development, featuring integrations with OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, and other major providers, along with RAG pipelines, OpenTelemetry observability, and enterprise security controls. The framework emphasizes production readiness, streaming capabilities, and Go's performance advantages for AI orchestration.

## Key Topics

- Go-native AI framework
- Agentic AI development
- LLM orchestration
- Streaming-first architecture
- Production-ready AI agents
- OpenTelemetry observability
- RAG pipelines
- 22+ LLM providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini)
- ReAct agent pattern
- Enterprise security (RBAC/ABAC)
- ChatModel abstraction
- Tool integration
- LiveKit real-time AI
- Open source (MIT License)
- Kubernetes deployment
